work.name: Pfizer
work.summary: Focused on AI applications in histopathology image processing and color normalization.
highlights: Optimized large-scale histopathology image processing workflows to improve efficiency and accuracy using advanced image analysis techniques.
Applied Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) for color normalization of histopathology images to enhance consistency and reliability in downstream analysis.
Used AI-based tools, such as QuPath, to detect abnormalities in histopathology images.
Contributed to a research paper related to histopathology image color normalization.

work.name: Artificial Intelligence In Ophthalmology Center
work.summary: Focused on AI applications in ophthalmology and small labeled data.
highlights: Participated in a research project aiming at creating a comprehensive review paper that explores the application of DL models in the field of glaucoma detection.
Analyzing Out-of-Distribution factors in DL models trained on the ophthalmic images.Analyzing Out-of-Distribution factors in DL models trained on the ophthalmic images.
Implementing semi-supervised segmentation techniques on the ophthalmic images.

work.name: University of Science and Technology
work.summary: Focused on AI applications in echocardiography images.
highlights: Collected 2-D echocardiography videos from the Cardiovascular-Medical and Research Center for research purposes.
Applied image processing techniques like filtering, segmentation, and object detection to analyze echocardiography images.
Utilized dimensionality reduction methods, including PCA, kernel-PCA, and LLE, to identify the mid-diastole frame, important for assessing Mitral Valve Stenosis (MS).
